accessRules: Admin role is required for every admin API and control-center feature.
Admins can activate or disable member accounts, assign member/admin roles, and update community ranks.
The platform owner account cannot be disabled or have its platform role changed.
The Platform Owner community rank can only be assigned to the founder account.
